answer.explanation: Between 15:41 and 15:51 UTC the Thumbnailer logged about 389 AccessDenied errors on s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/. The error says no identity-based policy allows the action for the role lambda-rca-bench-ThumbnailerRole-uSLz6w9BZbU1. Every invocation that reached the upload failed, which points to the execution role's policy lacking s3:PutObject on that prefix. The CrudApi, Uploader and Compression functions logged no errors in the window. I could not read IAM policies, the template or CloudTrail with the available tools, so which policy change removed the permission is unconfirmed.
